title: Canonical internal projection-formula helper maps
statement: For a pro-etale morphism of schemes with condensed commutative coefficient sheaf, use the published internal-module projection-formula interface: `ModuleObjectTensorGeneratorFormula` specifies the ordinary balanced tensor comparison on pure tensors; `ModuleObjectDerivedTensorFormula` specifies its total-complex lift and derived counit normalization; `existsUnique_moduleObjectDerivedTensorComparison` gives the unique comparison satisfying these formulas and invertibility; `moduleObjectDerivedTensorComparison` is that comparison; and `moduleObjectProjectionMate` is the counit mate of this comparison under the recorded derived upper-star/lower-star adjunction [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. The ambient internal-module categories and maps use [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom], [def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull-adjunction], and [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate].

source.place: canonical internal-module tensor comparison and projection mate used by the projection/exchange construction

proof.text: The coefficient pullback map is an isomorphism. The exact inverse-image mapMod functor preserves flat modules; extension of scalars along the coefficient isomorphism is isomorphic to restriction along its inverse. Thus the full module pullback preserves flat objects and has the generic left-derived tensor comparison.

Normalize the ordinary comonoidal comparison on balanced generators. First use the isomorphism between extension of scalars and restriction along the inverse coefficient map to compute its inverse tensorator after the extension units. Naturality of those units and the mapMod tensor projection formula give exactly ModuleObjectTensorGeneratorFormula. The balanced coequalizer is epimorphic, so this formula determines the ordinary map uniquely.

Apply the already proved source declarations Functor.leftDerivedTensorComparison, leftDerivedTensorComparison_app_app_comp_counit and HomologicalComplex.map_ιMapBifunctor_mapBifunctorComparisonX. Their equations on each (i,j) coproduct inclusion give the specified summand normalization and derived counit equation. Conversely that normalization determines q degree by degree using mapBifunctor.hom_ext_of_map. The proved generic Functor.leftDerived₂_ext then determines the derived transformation uniquely. The generic comparison is invertible, giving existence and uniqueness with the required IsIso condition. These are direct applications of the existing generic source API, not an invocation of the separate concrete pullback-comparison theorem. The generic representative formula is shared as tensorRepresentativeFormula; its pro-etale specialization has exactly the original quantified summand and counit equations.

Construct the normalized comparison as the published internal-module leftDerivedUpperStarTensor. The proved identification with the generic leftDerivedTensorComparison and its summand/counit formula prove moduleObjectDerivedTensorComparison_normalized. The unique-characterization theorem identifies this construction with its former selected witness. Form exactly the same counit mate under the existing derived adjunction.

lean.statement:
def moduleObjectProjectionMate
    (A : DerivedCategory
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X)))
    (B : DerivedCategory
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ Y))) :
    (lowerStar Λ f).rightDerivedFunctor.obj A ⊗ B ⟶
      (lowerStar Λ f).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
        (A ⊗ (upperStar Λ f).leftDerivedFunctor.obj B)
